project.title: Virtualized environment for fuzzing-based vulnerability assessment of vehicle communication protocols
project.description: This project assesses vulnerabilities in vehicle communication protocols through fuzzing. It uses a virtualized environment to simulate vehicles and their communication systems, automatically generating test cases to detect potential vulnerabilities.

info.goal.title: Project goal
info.goal.description: Build a virtualized lab environment to study vehicle communication protocols (CAN bus) safely, without a real vehicle. It is intended for research and training at CICATA, Queretaro.
info.environment.title: Virtualized environment
info.environment.description: The lab uses SocketCAN (vcan0 interface) and ICSim (Instrument Cluster Simulator by OpenGarages): a dashboard and a controls panel that exchange simulated CAN frames.
info.components.title: Components
info.components.description: ICSim (icsim and controls) simulates the vehicle cluster. This Python CLI drives the menu, language, and settings. The installer (install.sh) prepares system packages, Python libraries, and the Meson build.
info.usage.title: How to use the system
info.usage.description: After installing with install.sh, this menu lets you read project information, start the assessment, review results, check package versions, and configure the system.
info.author.title: Credits
info.author.description: Developed by Mendozainc-dev for CICATA (Center for Research in Applied Computing and Advanced Technology), Queretaro, Mexico. The cluster simulator is based on ICSim by OpenGarages.
